_note: Every key is optional; this file shows the full set. Omitted keys fall back to the built-in defaults (the values shown here).
public_csp: default-src * data: blob: 'unsafe-inline' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'

_env_only_settings._note: Set via environment variables only (no config.json key). See the README 'Configuration' table for the complete list and defaults.
_env_only_settings.OPENFABRICA_ADMIN_EXPOSE: Set to 1 to allow admin_bind_addr to be a non-loopback address (required to expose the admin panel off localhost).
_env_only_settings.OPENFABRICA_ALLOW_KEY_REGEN: Set to 1 to permit minting a new jwt.key/encryption.key when the file is missing but a database already exists. Off by default; regenerating invalidates every session and makes previously-encrypted secrets permanently unreadable.
_env_only_settings.OPENFABRICA_JWT_SECRET: Override the JWT signing key (min 32 chars; the jwt_secret config key does the same). Normally auto-generated at data/.security/jwt.key; prefer the key file over placing a secret here.
_env_only_settings.OPENFABRICA_ENCRYPTION_KEY: Override the at-rest encryption key (exactly 64 hex chars; the encryption_key config key does the same). Normally auto-generated at data/.security/encryption.key; prefer the key file over placing a secret here.
_env_only_settings.OPENFABRICA_MEMORY_LIMIT: Soft heap ceiling, e.g. 1GiB (0 disables). GOMEMLIMIT is honored when this is unset. See docs/SECURITY.md.
_env_only_settings.OPENFABRICA_OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE: How long Ollama keeps a model (and its prefix cache) resident between calls (e.g. 30m; -1 = forever; 0 = unload after each call).
_env_only_settings.OPENFABRICA_OLLAMA_NUM_CTX: Ollama context window for build calls; set at least as large as the build prompt (~16k+ tokens) so the cached prefix is not evicted.
